title: Find a pair that adds up
prompt: Return true when two numbers at different positions in values add up to target. The same position may not be used twice. Check every pair with a loop inside a loop.
hints: How do you make sure the two positions are different?
Let the inner index start one after the outer index, so that each pair is tried once.
for i from 0, for j from i + 1: return true when values[i] + values[j] equals target. Return false after both loops.
checkLabels: 2 may not be paired with itself.
Two equal numbers at different positions count.
An empty array has no pair.
The pair need not be next to each other.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Lets a number be paired with itself.
Tries only numbers that are next to each other.

feedback: List the pairs of positions your loops visit for a three-item array. Every pair of different positions should appear once.
